name: ARDY Core RP 20FPS
description: NVIDIA ARDY, the real-time autoregressive successor to Kimodo. Starts exactly from the current pose.

code.install: Nothing to install: ARDY is built into VNCCS Utils and runs in ComfyUI's own Python. The first generation downloads its checkpoint and the Llama 3 based text encoder (~17 GB) into models/text_to_motion.

requirements.notes: Runs inside ComfyUI, no separate install. About 16 GB of system RAM for the text encoder (kept off the GPU between prompts); the motion model itself is small. Foot-skate post-processing from the original release is not included.

guide.summary: Recommended. NVIDIA's newest model: generates in real time and starts exactly from the pose you made, up to 10 s.
guide.best_for: Continuing your pose; walking, gestures, everyday actions; quick iterations
guide.setup_effort: None: built in, downloads on first use

setup.label: Model and text encoder (~17 GB)
setup.detail: Built into VNCCS Utils, nothing to install. The first generation downloads the ARDY checkpoint and the LLM2Vec text encoder (Meta Llama 3 8B Instruct) into models/text_to_motion, so it takes a while once. The text encoder waits in system RAM and is moved to the GPU only while your prompt is read; closing the Motion panel frees everything.
